🎆🇺🇸 YOUR JULY 2026 CENTRAL TEXAS BUCKET LIST! 🇺🇸🎆

Looking for something fun this month?? I gotchu! 🙌
Here are 6 local events you don't wanna miss 👇✨

🎇 Temple H-E-B 4th of July Fun Fest
Sat July 4 · gates 6 PM · fireworks 9:30 PM
📍Crossroads Park, Temple (FREE! 🎉)

🎶 Red, White & Blue Music Festival
Sat July 4 · 6–10 PM · fireworks 9:30 PM
📍Historic Downtown Killeen (FREE 🎆)

🥳 Belton 4th of July Parade
Sat July 4 · parade 9 AM
📍Downtown Belton 🎺

🎬 Movies in Your Park: Lilo & Stitch 🌺
Fri July 10 · 7:30 PM
📍Zenner Family Aquatic Center, Killeen (FREE 🍿)

🎭 Zilker Summer Musical: Singin' in the Rain ☔
July 10–Aug 15
📍Zilker Hillside Theater, Austin (FREE!)

📌 SAVE this post & SHARE it with your crew! 👫👬👭

Thinking about making Central Texas your home?? 🏡💛
I'd LOVE to help you find your perfect spot! 📲 DM me anytime!
